'emerging' = a leading desk firing ahead of a quiet crowd with most of the move still ahead (where the edge is); 'exhausted' = already run, fade-risk. catalysts = fresh dated special-situation events. Every dossier names its falsifier and its edge_remaining; track both.

A central command that fuses five independent desks — news flow, alt-data smart-money, the divergence radar, the factor buy-board, and policy intent — into one reasoned read per name. Composite conviction rewards INDEPENDENT agreement across desks and is docked by an unanswered falsifier; the second/third-order flags name the setup. The bot sizes through its own risk framework; nothing here sizes alone.
